input.content:
import json, subprocess

teams = ["Windows 云端组", "Ubuntu 云端一组", "Ubuntu 云端二组", "Kali 云端一组", "Kali 云端二组"]
emps = ["员工A", "员工B", "员工C"]
for t in teams:
    print("=" * 8, t)
    for e in emps:
        r = subprocess.run(["agents", "workspace", "read", f"{e}/五言绝句.txt", "--team", t, "--json"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        try:
            d = json.loads(r)
        except Exception:
            print(f"  {e}: parse fail: {r[:120]}"); continue
        if not d.get("ok"):
            print(f"  {e}: ERROR {d.get('error')}"); continue
        c = d["data"]["content"]
        print(f"  --- {e} ({d['data']['bytes']}B)")
        print("    " + c.replace("\n", "\n    ").rstrip())
